uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2023-4770-5434-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2866-3200-4986-8095.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

6871-6879-7223-8095.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1981-2415-7918-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

252-1903-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-1903-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature that enters with at least five +1/+1 counters

1494-2382-5087--186.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a creature with haste that enters with at least five +1/+1 counters on it and creating a delayed triggered ability.
At the beginning of your end step, the delayed triggered ability from Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the creature token.
When the token leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

553-819-6555.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Whirlwing Stormbrood // Dynamic Soar.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

4742-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4742-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4742-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-2457-5434-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

250-779-1479-4862-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4862-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

270-2341-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Hedron Archive and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Hedron Archive and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Hedron Archive and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

465-3742-4251-4875-6968.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

5016-5109-6899.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Spitemare instead due to With Great Power....
Spitemare triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

1385-2173-4905-5220.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1350-2793-4779-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

222-527-2438-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3918-4306-4824.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least two.
3918-4306-4824.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1202-1477-1737-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1174-1479-3585.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-3585.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

3490-3545-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-3545-4050.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2916-4231-5856.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2916-4231-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

413-575-4221.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
413-575-4221.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Plane.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

999-3718.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
999-3718.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Leonin Lightscribe triggers, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Acid, destroying nothing and causing you to copy Chain of Acid, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3828-4395.notablePrerequisites: Druid's Call and Lightning Prowess attached to an indestructible creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3828-4395.description:
Activate the creature with Druid's Call and Lightning Prowess attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2550-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Emrakul's Hatcher.
Emrakul's Hatcher enters the battlefield, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

876-1666-1709.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Angelic Protector.
876-1666-1709.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Angelic Protector.
Angelic Protector triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Angelic Protector.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Angelic Protector, causing the opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

721-2724-4782.notablePrerequisites:
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
721-2724-4782.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Heider by paying {2} and tapping them, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

108-2713-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

803-1134-1267-3395.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai in hand.Preeminent Captain does not have summoning sickness.
"Sphinx" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
Opponents can not block and kill Preeminent Captain and Medomai.
803-1134-1267-3395.description:
Declare Preeminent Captain as an attacker.
Preeminent Captain triggers, putting Medomai from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Medomai, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Medomai to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
